mapper.sql: C.POPU_SITU , D.COMD_NAME AS POPU_SITU_NAME , C.POPU_CODE , C.MNGM_TITL , C.CONT_FIRS , C.CONT_SECO , C.CONT_THIR , C.CONT_FOUR , C.REGI_ADMN , NVL(RA.ADMN_NAME, C.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_ADMN , NVL(UA.ADMN_NAME, C.UPDT_ADMN) AS UPDT_ADMN_NAME , C.UPDT_DATE

P.POPU_SITU , P.POPU_SITU_NAME , P.POPU_CODE , P.MNGM_TITL , P.CONT_FIRS , P.CONT_SECO , P.CONT_THIR , P.CONT_FOUR , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select:
SELECT /* getPopupContentList */
FROM ( SELECT R.POPU_SITU , R.POPU_SITU_NAME , R.POPU_CODE , R.MNGM_TITL , R.CONT_FIRS , R.CONT_SECO , R.CONT_THIR , R.CONT_FOUR , R.REGI_ADMN , R.REGI_ADMN_NAME , R.REGI_DATE , R.UPDT_ADMN , R.UPDT_ADMN_NAME , R.UPDT_DATE , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT FROM CT_POPUPX C LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD D ON D.COMM_CODE = #{popupSituCode} AND D.COMD_CODE = C.POPU_SITU LEFT JOIN TM_ADMINX RA ON TO_CHAR(RA.ADMN_NUMB) = C.REGI_ADMN LEFT JOIN TM_ADMINX UA ON TO_CHAR(UA.ADMN_NUMB) = C.UPDT_ADMN ORDER BY C.POPU_SITU , C.POPU_CODE ) R WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB >= #{startRow}

SELECT /* getPopupContentDtl */
FROM CT_POPUPX C LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD D ON D.COMM_CODE = #{popupSituCode} AND D.COMD_CODE = C.POPU_SITU LEFT JOIN TM_ADMINX RA ON TO_CHAR(RA.ADMN_NUMB) = C.REGI_ADMN LEFT JOIN TM_ADMINX UA ON TO_CHAR(UA.ADMN_NUMB) = C.UPDT_ADMN WHERE C.POPU_SITU = #{popuSitu} AND C.POPU_CODE = #{popuCode}
